question: If all the vowels are removed from the English alphabet, then what will come at the 15th position in the new alphabetical series?
solution:
As per the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2775864c411b7b7effeab2b3c0808ee3cbf3ef1c3cedf2a7c11a799aea2bcd2e.png] 

If all the vowels ( a,e ,i ,o ,u) are removed in the English alphabet series, then the new arrangement will be:

B C D F G H J K L M N P Q R S T V W X Y Z

The 15th letter in the new alphabetical series:

 __B C D F G H J K L M N P Q R **S**__** **T V W X Y Z 

The 15th letter in the new alphabetical series is Letter "S".

Hence, the correct answer is **"Letter S"**.
